svg.title: Model Volumes: One Download per Model, Read-Only Everywhere
svg.desc: At admission the webhook decides which model a pod reads. A Lease names the one namespace whose Job downloads it. On block storage the Job downloads into a pod-local directory; the agent on its node measures the tree, creates a primary volume of that size in the nvsnap namespace, copies the tree in, and marks the volume complete. Every pod that reads the model gets a read-only view in its own namespace, landed at the path its engine already reads.
svg.text: Model Volumes: One Download per Model, Read-Only Everywhere
Block storage shown. On a filesystem shared while written, the Job writes straight into the primary through a read-write view, and readers mount at admission.
the first pod that needs the model
any function that reads the model
a static PV over the same volume,
The webhook decides the model from the pod (internal/modelid). The first admission for a model claims the download-owner Lease; a create only one admission can win. 2 The owner's Job downloads
The agent on the Job's node measures the tree, creates a claim of that size in the nvsnap namespace, copies the tree in, labels the retained volume complete and releases the claim, so the
volume detaches. After repeated failures it records the failure, and new pods download for themselves.
Once the volume is complete, a read-only view is minted in each reader's namespace. 5 In PVC mode the pod references the read-only claim; in hostPath mode it is scheduled at once on a hostPath
landing and the agent binds the volume in. Either way it lands at the path the engine already reads.
Under CRIU capture a restore placeholder gets only the landing, so CRIU can bind the mount the captured pod had.
